$comment: Mapping rules from the raw PoB snapshot to the catalog contract (apps/data-pipeline/src/normalize). Astrolabe vocabulary on the right side, PoB field names on the left; no game values.

uniqueLines.$comment: PoB writes unique lines that allocate a passive as this text (first capture group = node name), as generated for the unique jewel Megalomaniac (PoB data Uniques/Special/Generated.lua). Trusted repo configuration, not network input. A name shared by several nodes or by none leaves the line unresolved. grantsPattern: PoB writes granted skills as "Grants Skill: [Level (a-b) ]<skill name>" (PoB data Uniques/*.lua); the level range is not kept in grantsGemId, it stays in the line text.

modTiers.$comment: Tier 1 = highest required level within group + generation type + domains. Only these generation types are tiered.

essence.$comment: Essences become crafting actions from PoB's per-class mod table (Data/Essence.lua). op is the name agreed with the crafting thread (add-specific-mod, params modByItemClass); until packages/crafting-sim implements it the simulator reports the action as uncalibrated. PoB gives no rarity rule for essences, so none is set.

currency.$comment: Currency-like base items from the game-data tables (docs/adr/0005). itemClasses decides which CurrencyItems rows count; with includeExchangeItems every item of CurrencyExchange (the game's exchange list) counts too, whatever its class; items of other classes are reported as left out. Ids are BaseItemTypes.Id (metadata path), not PoB's name-based equipment ids.

gameIds.$comment: Game ids for the .build export (game data read in CI, approved by Christian 2026-11-25 23:13 UTC). Passives: the PassiveSkills row with the same node id (column PassiveSkillGraphId in the dat schema, the column PoB's export script calls PassiveSkillNodeId) and the same name; no match, several rows or another name leave the id out and are counted. Slots: PoB slot name -> Inventories.Id. Only slots whose inventory row has the same name are mapped. Weapon 2 and the swap slots stay unmapped until their pairing is verified in the game, as do flasks, charms, arms and legs.

releaseFacts.$comment: Facts of the release for the guide pipeline. maxLevelTable is a game-data table (config/data-pipeline/game-data.json). mainTree is a rule in PoB's code, not in its data: Build.lua allows 99 points at level 100 (usedMax), i.e. one point per level from level 2 on. classifications: PoB lists them in its code, damage types as dmgTypeList (Modules/CalcPerform.lua, CalcDefence.lua) and defence layers as the resourceList entries with defence = true (Modules/CalcDefence.lua), v0.23.1; the release id is the snake-case name and must be a mod tag of the release. Known limit: PoB hard-codes level 100 / 99 points, so a different maxCharacterLevel in the game data would not be reflected by PoB.
